title: Craftable Dragon Egg Recipe
description: Duplicate the DRAGON EGG like the SMITHING TEMPLATE and SHOW OFF TO YOUR FRIENDS!!!!
body:
# **Craftable Dragon Egg Recipe**

**Summon The Myth**

Only one Dragon Egg per world? Not anymore. This datapack lets you craft the ultimate trophy — no respawns, no rituals, just pure power in your hands.

Note: “Dragon Egg Recipe” is a custom recipe added by the datapack.If you are interested in more Datapacks check out the links at the end of the description.

**🧠 Why It’s Better**
Because legends shouldn’t be limited. Whether you're building a shrine, flexing your endgame status, or just want a few extra eggs for decoration, this pack makes the impossible… craftable. Downloading this as datapack is beneficial as you dont need to worry about downloading for a specific mod loader and it is compatible with the JEI mod

**📦 How to Use:**

1. Download the .zip
   
2. Drop it into your world’s datapacks/ folder
  
3. Type /reload in-game
    
4. Craft your legacy
